mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Features as secFeatures, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, c1.C_Name as glsWarranteeName, c2.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, c3.C_Name as glsBeneficiaryName, c1.C_Abbreviation as glsWarranteeAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as glbCompanyAbbName, d.D_name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, mn.* from Guarantee_Letter_Sign mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Gls_Warrantee=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on pro.P_Construction_Unit=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Department d on pro.P_Competent_Department=d.D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Gls_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Gls_Beneficiary=c3.C_Id where mn.Con_Id=#{conId} and mn.Gls_State=7 order by mn.Gls_State_Time desc limit 1

select pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Features as secFeatures, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, c1.C_Name as glsWarranteeName, c2.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, c3.C_Name as glsBeneficiaryName, c1.C_Abbreviation as glsWarranteeAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as glbCompanyAbbName, d.D_name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, panya.c_name as companyPartyAName, panyb.c_name as companyPartybName, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, mn.* from Guarantee_Letter_Sign mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on mn.Gls_Warrantee=c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on pro.P_Construction_Unit=c2.C_Id left join SYS_Department d on pro.P_Competent_Department=d.D_Id left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Gls_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on mn.Gls_Beneficiary=c3.C_Id left join sys_company panya ON con.Con_Party_A_Id = panya.c_id left join sys_company panyb ON con.Con_Party_B_Id = panyb.c_id where mn.Gls_Id=#{glsId}
